389.t: Singers take over and the end of orchestral dance music
389.s: He admires Sinatra's arrangers, says singers took over after dance bands faded, and ends his story.
389.q: And you take a guy like Sinatra, he don't have anything else. Even Andy Williams -- they're singers. But they can afford to go along with big bands,

124.s: McRae edited tapes at Capitol, including Sinatra material, and mostly wrote rather than played.
124.q: Well we did some other things for him, but, you know -- I think we did some of the -- I think a lot of tapes came in. I was working in the editing room -- we used to edit a lot of stuff. That was a good experience. I liked that. I --
